description: Scientific paper quality rubric for the automated paper-grading pipeline. Gemini evaluates paper metadata against four weighted categories (summing to a maximum of 100 points, with negative penalties for funding bias) to produce a total score mapped to letter grades A-E.

grade_bands.label: Fair — moderate quality or notable limitations
Poor — low-quality, high-bias, or penalized evidence

categories.label: Study Design / Hierarchy
categories.description: Where the study sits on the evidence hierarchy. Apply AMSTAR 2 risk-of-bias reasoning for systematic reviews and ROB2 reasoning for RCTs.

score_tiers.example: Systematic review or meta-analysis of RCTs, low AMSTAR 2 risk of bias
Double-blind, placebo-controlled human RCT, low-to-moderate ROB2 risk of bias
Single-blind or open-label human RCT; or well-controlled prospective cohort study
Observational/cross-sectional human study, or well-designed animal model
In-vitro/cell study, single case report, or non-peer-reviewed preprint

categories.label: Journal / Publisher Rigor
categories.description: Impact factor, peer-review rigor, and publisher reputation. Score conservatively if publisher is unidentified.

score_tiers.example: Top-tier journal (impact factor > 10), e.g. NEJM, JAMA, Nature, The Lancet
High-quality specialty journal (impact factor 4-10)
Reputable mid-tier peer-reviewed journal (impact factor 1-4)
Low-impact or lesser-known peer-reviewed journal
Predatory or non-peer-reviewed journal, self-published, or unidentified publisher

categories.label: Methodology & Sample
categories.description: Sample size, diversity, human vs animal vs cell model, and overall statistical power implied by abstract.

score_tiers.example: Large (200+), diverse human sample with adequate statistical power
Moderate (50-199) human sample, reasonably diverse
Small (<50) human sample, or narrow/homogeneous demographic
Animal model study (any sample size)
Cell/in-vitro study only, or sample details not reported

categories.label: Funding & Commercial Bias
categories.description: Evaluates funding sources and commercial conflicts of interest. Independent funding earns positive points (up to +10); heavy industry influence or suspicious commercial motives penalize the score (down to -10).

score_tiers.example: Fully independent funding (government/university grant), no conflicts of interest
Mixed funding (partial industry support), conflicts disclosed and transparently managed
Neutral / funding source undisclosed or not mentioned in available metadata
Primarily industry-funded or manufacturer-funded with author affiliations
Clear marketing bias, undisclosed industry funding, or suspicious commercial interference
